notes.title: Final Testing Phase – Release Incoming!
notes.notes:
Hi gamers! I have been working on finishing up Shape Warzone and I think I have quite a good build now! I will have a couple people test this version for any bugs or balancing issues, and once that is done and complete, I will finally release this game! 



If you have played the game before, I wanna let you know; I have updated the game massively since the last time I have announced something. I have added many new features, quality of life improvements and also new buildings, levels, a tutorial, and all sorts of things! The game has come quite far in the 1.5 years I have developed it and I can say that I am proud of my achievement here! Having a fully working game like this, built entirely by myself, still feels kind of surreal.



If you’re interested in the game, want to help test, share ideas, or follow my future projects, feel free to join our Discord community!

Thanks for the support! The release of Shape Warzone is coming soon(ish)! :D
